\section[(dialogue)]{Describing words — a first pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R155-first-pass-describing-words}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for hot and crowded.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item pleased, spacious, deep, round, sharp
  \item dark, colourful, elegant, strange, enjoyable
  \item delicious, low, high, wide, narrow
  \item thin, fat, wet, dry, dirty
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Pleased? (\textbf{\ar{مسرور}}, \emph{masrūr}.) Spacious? (\textbf{\ar{واسع}}, \emph{wāsiʿ}.) Deep? (\textbf{\ar{عميق}}, \emph{ʿamīq}.) Round? (\textbf{\ar{مستدير}}, \emph{mustadīr}.) Sharp? (\textbf{\ar{حاد}}, \emph{ḥādd}.) Dark? (\textbf{\ar{مظلم}}, \emph{muẓlim}.) Colourful? (\textbf{\ar{ملون}}, \emph{mulawwan}.) Elegant? (\textbf{\ar{أنيق}}, \emph{anīq}.) Strange? (\textbf{\ar{غريب}}, \emph{gharīb}.) Enjoyable? (\textbf{\ar{ممتع}}, \emph{mumtiʿ}.) Delicious? (\textbf{\ar{لذيذ}}, \emph{ladhīdh}.) Low? (\textbf{\ar{منخفض}}, \emph{munkhafiḍ}.) High? (\textbf{\ar{مرتفع}}, \emph{murtafiʿ}.) Wide? (\textbf{\ar{عريض}}, \emph{ʿarīḍ}.) Narrow? (\textbf{\ar{ضيق}}, \emph{ḍayyiq}.) Thin? (\textbf{\ar{نحيف}}, \emph{naḥīf}.) Fat? (\textbf{\ar{سمين}}, \emph{samīn}.) Wet? (\textbf{\ar{مبلل}}, \emph{muballal}.) Dry? (\textbf{\ar{جاف}}, \emph{jāff}.) Dirty? (\textbf{\ar{متسخ}}, \emph{mutassikh}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{More describing words — a second pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R155-second-pass-more-describing-words}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for sour and bitter.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item sour, bitter, soft, hard, clever
  \item lazy, brave, thirsty, fresh, ripe
  \item full, young, old, strong, weak
  \item necessary, ugly, precious, hot, crowded
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Sour? (\textbf{\ar{حامض}}, \emph{ḥāmiḍ}.) Bitter? (\textbf{\ar{مر}}, \emph{murr}.) Soft? (\textbf{\ar{ناعم}}, \emph{nāʿim}.) Hard? (\textbf{\ar{صلب}}, \emph{ṣulb}.) Clever? (\textbf{\ar{ذكي}}, \emph{dhakī}.) Lazy? (\textbf{\ar{كسول}}, \emph{kasūl}.) Brave? (\textbf{\ar{شجاع}}, \emph{shujāʿ}.) Thirsty? (\textbf{\ar{عطشان}}, \emph{ʿaṭshān}.) Fresh? (\textbf{\ar{طازج}}, \emph{ṭāzaj}.) Ripe? (\textbf{\ar{ناضج}}, \emph{nāḍij}.) Full? (\textbf{\ar{مليء}}, \emph{malīʾ}.) Young? (\textbf{\ar{شاب}}, \emph{shābb}.) Old? (\textbf{\ar{عجوز}}, \emph{ʿajūz}.) Strong? (\textbf{\ar{قوي}}, \emph{qawī}.) Weak? (\textbf{\ar{ضعيف}}, \emph{ḍaʿīf}.) Necessary? (\textbf{\ar{ضروري}}, \emph{ḍarūrī}.) Ugly? (\textbf{\ar{قبيح}}, \emph{qabīḥ}.) Precious? (\textbf{\ar{ثمين}}, \emph{thamīn}.) Hot? (\textbf{\ar{ساخن}}, \emph{sākhin}.) Crowded? (\textbf{\ar{مزدحم}}, \emph{muzdaḥim}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
